name: 164a: AR + no-LN Spatial Transformer + VS + Direct Output
theory: AR with GRU feedback fixes cointegration (ablation: -29% without). No-LN preserves per-cell magnitude (eff_rank 2.68 vs 1.78). tanh bounds extremes (163a diagnostic). VS provides conditionality gradient (turb/calm=1.462). Direct output: model learns mean and spread together.

architecture.encoder: GRU + attention pool, random init, E2E
architecture.decoder: Spatial transformer (25 cells/frame), no-LN, tanh, LayerScale 0.1
architecture.generation: AR frame-by-frame, GRU feedback per frame
architecture.loss: afCRPS + VS lambda=0.5, per-frame at D=25

eval_protocol: 5-stage: training monitor → v2 suite → 7 diagnostics → long-horizon → failure mapping
kill_condition: Training diverges at <20ep OR v2 suite < 3/9 at 80ep OR cointegration no improvement over 161a

follow_ups.164h: tanh hit rate > 5% → remove tanh, try AGC

result: 164a: 4/9 (boundary exploit), 164a_v2: 4/9 (correct scale, train-test mismatch), 164a_v3: 5/9 (GRU feedback fixes conditionality+cointegration). Rank-1 identified as remaining bottleneck.

name: 164b: AR + no-LN Spatial Transformer + VS + Mean+Residual
theory: Same as 164a but with MeanPredictor. Separates mean trajectory (deterministic) from stochastic residual. Tests Q2: does MeanPredictor help under AR? Old AR model effectively direct (KS=20/25), 161a residual (KS=16/25). Under AR, MeanPredictor may be redundant.
target: Same as 164a. Compare KS, CI, kurtosis against 164a.
reason: Rank-1 fix is higher priority. 164b would have same rank-1 issue. Revisit after rank-1 is resolved.

name: H1: Increase VS lambda to break rank-1 (lambda_vs=5.0)
theory: VS has 41% sensitivity to rank structure (verified). At lambda=0.5, VS is 20x too weak relative to CRPS — crossover at lambda~10 where multi-factor becomes preferred. 99k showed ES broke rank-1 at ep10 but CRPS pulled it back at lambda=1.0. Higher VS lambda should sustain the factor structure.
target: eff_rank > 2.5 sustained through training. Cross-cell correlation ratio in [0.5, 2.0]. Per-cell spread variation matching GT (85x range).
kill_condition: Stage 1 (30ep): eff_rank stays below 2.0. Stage 2 (80ep): eff_rank peaks then collapses (99k pattern).
if_fails: Confirms loss-based rank-1 fix is fundamentally insufficient. Proceed to H2.

name: H2: Per-cell noise in ConditionalNorm (only if H1 fails)
theory: TRIZ resolution: CRPS voting conflict (19 cells vs 3) exists because shared z forces all cells to share one scale. Per-cell noise z_c decouples cells. FCN3 uses 8 multi-scale noise channels (analogous). FGN uses spatially-shared noise but has GNN inductive bias we lack.
architecture: Modify ConditionalNorm to accept per-cell noise z_c ~ N(0, I_d) independently per cell.
kill_condition: Stage 2 (30ep): eff_rank doesn't improve. Stage 3: CRPS still can't calibrate.
if_fails: Points to FactorNoiseSkip bypass or different decoder architecture.
